1789285341_lr.jpg.description: A medium-sized Indian living room designed with a warm, minimal and contemporary aesthetic, combining neutral beige tones with natural wood and subtle traditional Indian elements. The space uses clean-lined furniture, warm ambient lighting, indoor plants, brass accents and Indian artwork without making the room feel crowded. The layout keeps plenty of open floor space, making it practical for everyday family living.
